decisions.reason: The standard quarter-pallet shelf display is a core format that likely still meets aspirations as retail promotions recover after COVID, but it has not been shown on the website since 2019, which suggests reduced emphasis after the firm pruned most of its 2018 launches.

The wooden display pallet lies outside the cardboard core and has not been shown since 2019, and the 2021–2022 wood price surge likely pushed its results below aspiration, so problemistic search favours moving its resources back to cardboard displays and new development.
